name: Fallen Star Forge (Tinh Lạc Lô Cụ)

bonuses.rule: each Fire art you fire heats your sword one step, each step giving your Metal sword arts 4 % pierce. Once it holds 5 steps or more, your next sword art quenches it: a certain crit that counts as a Thunder strike on your blade (Sky Iron Sings wakes), and the steps clear.

story: Made in his first years as head: the star sword of 1050, the brand that marked it, and the robe the quench-keeper sewed for him in 1060. Whole since then.
